MDWC_Adrenaline.description.english: A shot of adrenaline, fading in levels. Pain is dulled and movement, sight and thought are quickened, while the body burns through its rest faster and faster as the surge fades.

MDWC_WarcasketHelmet_Medic.description.english:
Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with standard protection, fitted with a diagnostic visor that lets the mechanite dressing treat disease and infection as well as wounds.

A 10th-generation spacer chassis refitted for the medic's role: the pilot is welded in for good, like any warcasket wearer, but this one is built to keep the rest of the squad alive rather than to break the line.

The medic series trades firepower for the tools to treat wounds under fire, so a squad that fields one can stay in the fight long after its stims and bandages have run out.

MDWC_WarcasketTrait_Medic.degreeDatas.wa.english:
{PAWN_nameDef} is entombed in a warcasket. Pain has no effect on {PAWN_objective}, and {PAWN_pronoun} can never go into pain shock or drop unconscious from it.

Built for treating the wounded, the suit leaves {PAWN_objective} free to doctor, but it is too bulky for most other work.

MDWC_AdrenalineShot.description.english: Inject a nearby person or animal with a dose of adrenaline drawn from a medical kit. For a few hours they feel almost no pain and move, see and think faster, while their rest falls much faster than usual. On a patient with a heart attack the shot is spent on the heart instead.

MDWC_MechaniteDressing.description.english:
Stream medicine-laden mechanites onto a nearby person or animal to tend their wounds where they stand, most urgent first. Tend quality depends on the pilot's medical skill and the medicine used, and the skill sets the pace.

Reloads with medicine.
